verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is documented as a single dependency-free binary (meilisearch-docs-11). Community users ran 1M records on an $8/mo instance and ~80M documents on one server (meilisearch-comm-18, meilisearch-comm-15), so infrastructure cost can stay low and predictable. Against that, one team found RAM usage under heavy search traffic too unpredictable and expensive (meilisearch-comm-5), and a user reported a jump from the free tier to a $1200/month cloud plan, though pay-as-you-go exists (meilisearch-comm-2). Missing for 10: documented cloud pricing model (usage dimensions, per-search/per-record rates, absence of per-request overage cliffs), first-party guidance on capacity and cost planning as query volume grows, and corroboration of smooth cloud plan scaling.
